court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: CRP No. 1885 of 2026 & CMP. No. 8469 of 2026
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Mala, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the decreeholder is withdrawing the Execution Proceedings with liberty to file a fresh EP, before the territorial jurisdictional Court. Therefore, the learned counsel sought for withdrawal of the present Civil Revision Petition. The learned counsel has also made an endorsement in the petition to that effect.

2. Recording the submission and the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Civil Revision Petition is dismissed as withdraw. Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
